title: BOOK-101 - View Available Rooms
description: Visitors can browse available rooms with details and book them.
acceptance_criteria: Each room shows: Name, Description, Price, Room image, Amenities.
Rooms are displayed in a consistent layout.
"Book Now" button is visible for every room.
If no rooms exist, an empty state message is displayed.

test_cases.title: display_all_active_rooms_with_details
preconditions: There are active rooms available in the system.
test_cases.expected_result: All active rooms are displayed with Name, Description, Price, Room image, and Amenities.

test_cases.title: verify_consistent_layout_of_rooms
preconditions: There are active rooms available in the system.
test_cases.expected_result: Rooms are displayed in a consistent layout.

test_cases.title: check_book_now_button_visibility
preconditions: There are active rooms available in the system.
test_cases.expected_result: "Book Now" button is visible for every room.

test_cases.title: display_empty_state_message_when_no_rooms
preconditions: There are no active rooms available in the system.
test_cases.expected_result: An empty state message is displayed.
